# Android 5 compatibility changes

Vendored from the official pub.dev `flame_barrage` 0.0.7 archive:
https://pub.dev/api/archives/flame_barrage-0.0.7.tar.gz

Archive SHA256: `704a7eeacee75ceb4dd1ab006bf7b0de97e5cf00174e27d2001ba65191d751e8`.
The original license is preserved in `LICENSE`.

- Allow Dart 3.8.1 and Flutter 3.32.8.
- Pin Flame 1.35.1, the newest stable Flame release with Dart >=3.8 and
  Flutter >=3.32 declared support. Flame 1.36 requires Dart 3.11/Flutter 3.41.
